reviews.text: At the beginning I blindly trusted the doctor to follow my cat, despite many explanations due to the refusal of the diagnosis that could be fatal for my cat, there was an annoying insistence on her part, then subsequently I had some checks, hemolyzed tests and illegible ultrasound, paid handsomely, she did not seem at all interested in following my cat with criteria if I had listened to her perhaps now he would even be dead luckily I was well documented and knew how to treat my cat, my experience was totally negative, with me she was unprofessional.
Professionals with a lot of humanity

If I could, I'd give Dr. Jori and Dr. Ciaramella's veterinary practice 10 stars! The entire team offers incredible expertise (they call in high-level specialists for any situation that requires it) and extraordinary humanity and helpfulness. Our dog, a Bernese Mountain Dog puppy, who has been followed closely for months, has just recently had a spay/neuter procedure: if I hadn't known, I never would have mentioned it! A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Jori and the entire team, including the receptionist! ❤️

The best veterinarians I've ever met! Expertise, kindness, and endless availability are what distinguish Dr. Riccardo Jori and Dr. Ciaramella. I've been their client for almost 20 years and I wouldn't change them. In addition to providing the best possible care for my animals, they also manage my countless anxieties, which they absolutely shouldn't have to deal with. The serenity and affection with which they carry out their work every day makes them unique.
Dr. Jori is very kind and helpful. He saved my puppy and is now caring for her with great patience. He's so good and loving with animals. I will never stop thanking him.

My dog ​​loves going to Dr. Ciaramella.
Professionalism and a warm welcome are always there!
Recommended for all animal lovers looking for expert veterinarians!
